video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows how an AI image generator (a diffusion model) draws a picture by clearing noise step by step

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the next part of the wall

tile_flip.what: A square tile in the picture flips over in place and shows a new colour

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

jump_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself from the left edge into the empty picture frame

jump_label_enter.what: The label 'one jump' fades in and rises above the arrow

jump_cross_draw.what: A navy cross draws itself over the arrow, one stroke after the other

jump_exit.what: The arrow, its label and the cross fade away

noise_ring_draw.what: A violet ring draws itself around a handful of speckled tiles

noise_label_enter.what: The label 'noise' fades in and rises under the ring

brush_enter.what: A paint brush fades in beside the ringed tiles

brush_sweep.what: The brush sweeps across the ringed tiles from left to right and the speckles it passes turn clean

brush_exit.what: The brush fades away after its sweep

noise_closeup_exit.what: The ring and its label fade away

dial_track_draw.what: The step dial's track draws itself from left to right below the frame

dial_notches_enter.what: Five round notches appear on the dial one after another

dial_icons_enter.what: A small cat icon and a speckle icon fade in at the two ends of the dial

knob_enter.what: The violet knob appears at the left end of the dial

knob_click.what: The violet knob slides one notch along the dial

knob_travel.what: The violet knob glides several notches along the dial in one move

add_noise_arrow_draw.what: A purple arrow draws itself to the right under the dial

add_noise_label_enter.what: The label 'add noise' fades in and rises under the arrow

add_noise_exit.what: The 'add noise' arrow and label fade away

ai_pill_enter.what: The AI pill fades in and rises into place under the dial

ai_pill_swell.what: The AI pill swells slightly and settles back when a cluster of noise tiles drops into it

guess_arrow_draw.what: A violet arrow draws itself from the AI pill up to the picture frame

guess_arrow_exit.what: The arrow between the AI pill and the frame fades away

guess_outlines_enter.what: Violet outlines appear around the tiles the AI guesses are noise

guess_outlines_exit.what: Each violet outline fades as its tile lifts away

noise_cluster_lift.what: Purple noise tiles lift out of the frame, travel down the arrow, shrink and drop into the AI pill

noise_cluster_fade.what: Each purple noise tile fades out as it reaches the AI pill

mini_frames_enter.what: A row of four small picture frames slides in from the right and fades in above the cat

mini_noise_fill.what: Noise tiles flip in over each small picture, then flip away again

mini_frames_exit.what: The row of small frames slides off to the left and fades

counter_enter.what: A number fades in beside the AI pill

counter_count.what: The number beside the AI pill counts upward steadily and ends on the word 'millions'

chip_enter.what: The prompt chip fades in and rises into place above the frame

chip_typing.what: The prompt text 'a cat' is typed letter by letter

chip_link_draw.what: A violet line draws itself from the prompt chip down to the AI pill

wall_exit.what: The dial, AI pill, prompt chip and arrows fade away, leaving only the picture

old_frame_enter.what: The practice cat returns as a smaller frame, fading in and rising beside the new cat

not_equal_draw.what: A violet not-equal sign draws itself between the two frames, stroke by stroke

magnifier_enter.what: A magnifier fades in over the new cat

magnifier_slide.what: The magnifier slides across the new cat and stops on one paw

badge_enter.what: The badge 'Check the details' fades in and rises under the new cat

compare_exit.what: The frame outlines, the practice cat, the sign, the magnifier and the badge fade away

tiles_regroup.what: The new cat's tiles shrink, turn purple and gather into four small columns

tiles_into_bars.what: Each column of tiles fades away as a logo bar grows out of it

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises under the wordmark

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen
